dialogues.speaker: Diether
dialogues.text: Daddy, they say in Springvale that Fontaine's the homeland of the water fairies, right?

dialogues.speaker: Diether
dialogues.text: In that case, we'll definitely see them here, won't we?

dialogues.speaker: Dietmar
dialogues.text: We will, of course we will — and Daddy will help you find them!

dialogues.speaker: Dietmar
dialogues.text: But I asked some of the locals, and they say that Oceanids are very shy, and that we need to work hard to see them with our own eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Dietmar
dialogues.text: You're a good, patient lad, aren't you, Diether? You'll wait for Daddy to find them, right?
